description: This file defines the OrderProduct entity class for an e-commerce system, including its fields, relationships, and accessor methods.

classes.name: OrderProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing a product within an order, including SKU, name, quantity, charges, and related attributes, prices, and downloads.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order product.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product in the order.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product in the order.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates the order product with a specific Order.

methods.name: getOrderAttributes
methods.description: Returns a set of attributes related to the order product.

methods.name: setOrderAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes related to the order product.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Returns the set of prices associated with this product.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the prices associated with this product.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Returns the set of downloadable items for this product.

methods.name: setDownloads
methods.description: Sets the downloadable items for this product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU code for the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU code for the product.

methods.name: getOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Returns the one-time charge associated with the product.

methods.name: setOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Sets the one-time charge for the product.
